mapper.insert: INSERT into ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_membership_grade ( grade_name, grade_rule, grade_discount, grade_start, grade_url ) VALUES (#{param.gradeName}, #{param.gradeRule}, #{param.gradeDiscount}, 1, #{param.gradeUrl})
mapper.select: select grade_name,grade_url,grade_discount from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_membership_grade where id=#{classId} and grade_start = 1
select grade_name,grade_rule from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_membership_grade where grade_start = 1 and grade_rule > #{presentInteger} ORDER BY grade_rule limit 1
select grade_discount from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_membership_grade where grade_start = 1 order by grade_discount asc limit 1
